review.headline: Long run 16 km completed at a steady, controlled 5:47/km, squarely inside the easy band.
observations: Distance 15.995 km in 5550 s moving time, avg 5:47/km, which sits within the planned 5:11-6:13/km easy range and well off tempo effort.
Pace was remarkably even: 15 of 16 splits at 5:48/km, with one 5:38 split at km 9 and no fade over the second half.
Average HR 142 with max 145 and a tight split-to-split range (140-144) shows the run stayed aerobic and unhurried, matching the 'steady and unhurried' intent.
Efficiency 1.218 is close to the recent easy-run value of 1.273, consistent with a relaxed effort rather than a push.
flags: RPE was not logged, so perceived effort cannot be cross-checked against the heart-rate picture.
Fueling for race day was part of the brief but no note was recorded on fueling or how the run felt.
